cd /code && Rscript - <<'EOF'
load('../data/ratingData5')
# mimic script
ratingData5$USval <- ifelse(substr(as.character(ratingData5$correspondingUS), 1, 1) == 'p', 'positive', 'negative')
ratingData5$USval <- as.factor(ratingData5$USval)
ratingData5Aggr <- aggregate(likingRating ~ ParticipantNumber * USval * correspondingTime, ratingData5, mean)
ratingData5AggrW <- reshape(ratingData5Aggr, idvar=c('ParticipantNumber','correspondingTime'), timevar='USval', direction='wide')
# merge vis data and exclusions from script
load('../data/visData5')
load('../data/DemoData5')
ExclList5 <- c(4,5,7,13,30,66,160,116)
# process vis
visData5Aggr <- aggregate(correctAnswer ~ ParticipantNumber * Length, visData5, mean)
tmpVis <- subset(visData5Aggr, !Length %in% c(158,170))
tmpVis <- subset(tmpVis, !(ParticipantNumber %in% ExclList5))
tmpVis <- aggregate(correctAnswer ~ ParticipantNumber * Length, tmpVis, FUN=sum)
names(tmpVis)[names(tmpVis)=='Length'] <- 'correspondingTime'
ratingData5AggrW <- merge(ratingData5AggrW, tmpVis, by=c('ParticipantNumber','correspondingTime'))
ratingData5AggrW$EC <- ratingData5AggrW$likingRating.positive - ratingData5AggrW$likingRating.negative
print(aggregate(EC ~ correspondingTime, ratingData5AggrW, mean))
print(aggregate(EC ~ correspondingTime, ratingData5AggrW, function(x) c(mean=mean(x), n=length(x))))
EOF
